== History ==
The Clan was founded on September the 2nd, [[2007]] as a consequence of the [[Team Building Initiative]] started by [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Itsinen]]. The members were thus somewhat randomly selected with regard to their geographical location. The clan signed up to perform in [[EQL Season 6]].
{| width="100%"
| valign="top" width="10%" |

|}


Beginning of the year 2008 team changed it's name from Coitus Interruptus to plain Coitus. And also the clan tag changed from CI to coi. All this before entering NQR11. Some members were also removed and some added.
